verdict.rationale: Cline has no dedicated bulk or batch feature, but it covers much of the story through other mechanisms. It makes coordinated multi-file changes, runs many agents in parallel from the Kanban board with isolated worktrees, spawns parallel subagents, and supports headless CLI scripting with auto-approve and cron schedules. Missing for 10: an explicit batch or bulk-apply capability across many items or repos, documentation of bulk-operation workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of parallel or bulk runs.
